note: Chippewa National Forest campground, formerly Knutson Dam, where the Mississippi River leaves Cass Lake; 6 miles east of Cass Lake on US-2, then 5 miles north on County Road 10. A single loop on mown lawn under oak, spruce and pine. Boat ramps on both the lake and the river, and easy canoe access to the Mississippi. --Claude
summary: rec.gov read: 11 back-in sites + 2 walk-to tent, no hookups, vault toilets + water, $16 (2026/2027), 2-night weekend minimum, FCFS after the reservation season. Riverfront -> creekside flagged (outlet channel ~20-25 m wide at sites 001-002). Uniform 40-ft lengths not written. No season written.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> creekside (channel-width rule, reviewer to confirm). Sites 001 (47.45022,-94.48348) and 002 (47.45019,-94.48309) sit on open lawn about 15-18 m from the Mississippi's outlet channel below Knutson Dam, but the channel there is only about 20-25 m wide on zoom-19 imagery (measured at 47.4500,-94.4831), under the doc's ~30 m line ('decided by SIZE, not by name ... Measure at the campground'). Site 003 (47.45020,-94.48267) is about 10 m from the bank but under trees. If the reviewer reads the Mississippi as a river regardless of width, riverfront stands on 001-002. Sites 009 and 011 face Cass Lake about 37-43 m away through a continuous tree band (a view, not lakefront). The campground is beside the dam but level with the lake, not below a berm; 001-003 face the tailwater. All sites are sold by the night.

Site lengths: the RIDB catalog gives every site, including the management and tent sites, exactly 40 ft Driveway Length and Max Vehicle Length. That looks like a placeholder, so max_rig_ft is not written. A 23-ft rig is not in doubt.
Discount not written (the schema has no key for it): rec.gov facility_rules carry tribalDiscount 1, 'Leech Lake Band of Ojibwe (407)'.
Rec.gov 'Paved Sites' and 'Paved Roads' amenities and 'Waterfront Sites' are listed; the description says 'Every site affords scenic lake views' (marketing, not used).
Season: rec.gov rate seasons (Peak 05-08 to 09-04 in 2026, FCFS 09-05 to 09-08) are not a campground season statement; season left absent.
Phone 218-835-4291 (rec.gov facility phone) and website confirmed. Pin 47.450576,-94.483249 is in the middle of the loop, about 60 m from the rec.gov facility point; no move.
